title: AI Guardrails Fail Offensive Cybersecurity Researchers
excerpt: AI guardrails from companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are blocking legitimate security research while failing to stop malicious actors. This article explores the impact on offensive cybersecurity researchers, the rise of specialized tools, and the call for more nuanced, context-aware safety measures.
